_comment: wq#5200: cli_tools entries for a Limpet MCP meta-server (lib/mcp/manifest.json schema) running where /home/lumen/bin/re-orchestrate and ssh to maksoor exist (i.e. Lumen, not the Farida ISO). re_fingerprint/re_plan never run tools: read_only. re_run executes tools on maksoor, so it is energizing and sits behind the Sentinel gate (wq#5087); re-orchestrate's own permission gate still applies inside it (write/hw_read need --approve, hw_write needs a Frank wq ticket, network is blocked).

cli_tools.name: re_fingerprint
cli_tools.description: Fingerprint an RE target: format, arch, OS, vendor/SoC hints, embedded formats (nested). JSON.

cli_tools.name: re_plan
cli_tools.description: Structured investigation plan from the capability registry: ranked tool chains, stages with fallbacks, gate preview, resource limits. Runs nothing.

cli_tools.name: re_run
cli_tools.description: Run the auto stages of the plan on maksoor (resource-limited, network-isolated, read-only target) and write evidence envelopes under /home/lumen/re/evidence/<project>/<analysis_id>/.
